repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until((#Main_Window).windowCovering_currentPosition > 0)
triggered = false
}
wait until((#Main_Window).windowCovering_currentPosition > 0)
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("The window is open")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait for `WindowCovering.CurrentPosition > 0`. The candidate uses `<= 0` in the rearming wait, which is the logical opposite of the required condition. Evidence F2 shows the JoI emitted no action at 1100ms while the IR did, because the condition was true (1) and the candidate's guard (`<= 0`) was false, preventing the body from executing.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the rearming wait condition from `<= 0` to `> 0` to match the IR's rising-edge requirement. This ensures the automation blocks until the position drops below the threshold before waiting for it to rise again, correctly implementing the rising-edge semantics.
